name: text-along-path

frames.best_why: Words are spread around all four sides and the button shows its finished Done state.

tagline: Blue monospace words march around a rounded rectangle like a ticker.
summary: A line of repeated text travels endlessly along a rounded rectangle outline, wrapping from one side to the next. It can loop on a timer or follow the reader's scroll, with room in the middle for a form.
appearance: Lowercase blue monospace words repeat in a continuous loop around a large rounded rectangle on black, running upside down and right to left along the bottom edge. In the middle sit a thin outlined email field and a solid blue Subscribe button.
behaviour: The words slide clockwise around the track without a visible seam, since a second copy chases the first. Typing an address and submitting swaps the button label for a spinner, then a Done tick, and later returns to its resting state.
demo_content: Repeated "join the waitlist ✉" text around an email field and a Subscribe button that ends on Done.
search_phrases: words that travel along a border
svg text along a path animation
text going round a rounded box
use_when: A launch or waitlist page wants its call to action framed by moving text that pulls the eye.
avoid_when: The loop runs forever with no pause and ignores reduced motion, and words clip where the path meets the crop.
customise: Path data, the text, viewBox, font classes and animation mode are props, with duration, repeat count and easing for the loop and offsets for scroll mode.
weight_why: Two duplicated text paths on an SVG timer; cheap, but it animates for as long as it is visible.

a11y.note: The moving words are decorative and unlabelled, and the loop never pauses for reduced-motion users.

issues: Words are clipped mid-letter where the path runs past the crop edges.
On the bottom run the text is upside down, so it reads right to left and is hard to parse.
polish_why: Crisp seamless loop and a strong accent; clipping and the inverted bottom run let it down.
title: Text Along Path
